result.summary: Enables several clang-tidy bugprone checks in the linter configuration, including bugprone-unused-raii, bugprone-string-literal-with-embedded-nul, bugprone-inaccurate-erase, and bugprone-return-const-ref-from-parameter. It also updates flagged call sites, fixing a test bug and replacing an erase-remove idiom with std::erase.
result.problem: Clang-tidy is not configured to catch certain subtle programming errors, such as unused RAII locks, embedded NUL characters in string literals, inaccurate container erases, or parameters missing lifetime annotations.
evidence: PR description: 'Apart from a test-only bug, they didn't find anything severe, but I think it still makes sense to enable them, so that it is easier to read the resulting code.'

result.card: Enables several clang-tidy bugprone checks and fixes the code patterns they flag across the repository. Clang-tidy currently does not check for issues like unused RAII objects, inaccurate container erasing, or parameters needing lifetime annotations. The author notes that apart from one test-only bug the new checks did not uncover severe issues in current code, but will help catch future defects in CI.
